Hi Voat. I am Chad owner of Greater Than Management. We’re proud to announce a plan that delivers something different than what we’ve grown to be familiar with in the CS:GO world. We’re developing a 3v3 game mode breaking the current rules of traditional 5v5 game modes.

Players will be competing for an evolving prize pool starting at $1.5k! Sponsors, crowd funding and micro-transactions will help increase the prize pool amounts.

This new format is faster, action-packed and more streamlined than its 5v5 predecessor. A format that is constantly evolving and forcing the competition to always be ready for something exciting and new.

This inaugural 3v3 event is a first of its kind with no entry fees for competitors. Registration can be found at our website http://greaterthan.gg

The play styles are unique compared to the typical 5v5. Here are some rule sets that will be introduced and some explanations behind those changes:

-Introduction of Teams Teams can consist of as many players that can enroll their entire team to play in 3v3 tournaments. All players will represent the teams and will be placed randomly into the brackets. Occasionally, they may have to compete against one another. Should both squads under one team make it to the grand finals - that team can be declared the winner and all players will receive the combined 1st and 2nd place prize pool. - Benched teammates When one half of a Teams has been eliminated from the event, they become benched players for the remaining three players and can be actively swapped in and out of the game based on preset rules provided on the http://greaterthan.gg website. -Referees In game, referees will moderate the game to ensure players are following event rules. Some examples include: Enforcing timeout rules, penalizing players for misconduct, or cheating. -Smaller maps Valve produced maps in the demolition list. As well as some cs maps. Referees will set each week.

Details: 10 weeks of regular season games with 6 maps total 3v3 game mode More action-packed and more play time Competitive voice communication is allowed Teamspeak will be offered through a separate voice channel

Player Conduct: Economic penalties will be given for derogatory communication, excessive trash-talking, etc in game Repeat offenders will result in a more severe penalty TBD 2 referees will impose penalties based on the rules and restrictions; if needed, an on-scene commissioner will decide the penalty based on the issue

The main plan for all of this is not to overshadow and get rid of the 5v5 competitive scene, but rather it be an optional meta for an easier-to-access competitive environment. If you are interested in this league, please join our discord channel! You can find a friend, a team, or just hang out. =)

[Discord](https://discord(delete space) .gg/sGH32WB)

If you have any further questions, please send me an email: support@greaterthan.gg I’ll do my best to get back to you quickly.

Seeing that this is our ALPHA season, all rules and regulations are subject to change**
